description: Everything the KOL B prototype downloads, pinned. Weights are NOT stored in git or Drive; fetch them from these exact sources and verify SHA-256 (see README 'Setup').

llm.quantization: int8 dynamic on linears + embedding; 36 GatedDeltaNet decay/gate projections float; fp32 activations declared; weights in TFLiteWeights sections (external weights, since 2026-11-09)
modelCardNotes: one Engine per conversation (LiteRT-LM #3165; fix on main e1f86b05, not in 0.19.1)
Android GPU needs LiteRT-LM >= 0.19.0 for this file
Qwen3.5-2B is NOT in the official 'Web LLM Models' collection

alternativeTestedForWebOnly.why: same TFLite graph/weights with the weights inside the graph; tried only because the WASM CPU path cannot read external weights; it failed too (XNNPACK runtime creation, wasm32 4 GB). Not used by the prototype.

comparedOnly.result: same external-weight failure on CPU; not used

hostEvaluationOnly.note: content evaluation on the VM CPU; not an on-device result

vad.model: silero_vad_v5.onnx (bundled in the npm package; Silero VAD, MIT)

tts.runtime: onnxruntime-web 1.31.1 (MIT) + @diffusionstudio/piper-wasm 1.0.0 (MIT, espeak-ng phonemizer; espeak-ng is GPL-3.0 — check before product use)

notUsed.tr_TR-fettah/fahrettin: removed upstream on 2025-12-30 'at request of contributors' (rhasspy/piper-voices b145f2ac26)

tts.voiceIdentity: Prototype-specific voices. NOT the approved female-calm-v1 voice and not presented as equivalent.

validator.onDevice: Pyodide 314.0.7 (MPL-2.0) in the page; pydantic replaced by a stand-in module for the import only
